label: October 19–25, 2026
intro: Halloween is HERE — Siam haunts on Sunday, Chocolate Ville keeps the spooky season rolling all week!
weekday_note: Weekdays this week are perfect for a final Roller Dome or ice rink session before the big Halloween weekend push on Saturday–Sunday.

activities.title: Siam Halloween 2026
activities.price: Free to attend (some activity booths may charge)
activities.why: Bangkok's biggest Halloween street party kicks off Sunday at Siam Square — costumes, characters, themed zones, and a high-energy atmosphere. Thor in his Iron Man suit will fit right in with the superhero crowd.
activities.tip: Sunday Oct 25 is the opening day — go early before the evening crush. Siam is easy on the BTS. Pack a light snack and plan for 2–3 hours of wandering.

activities.title: Chocolate Ville Spooky Town — Peak Halloween
activities.date: Any day this week (runs Oct 1 – Nov 7)
activities.price: Entry fee applies (check Chocolate Ville website)
activities.why: A whole Halloween village — haunted decor, costume parade, Ghostbuster show, family atmosphere. This is peak spooky season here, perfect for a 5-year-old who wants fun-scary not nightmare-scary.
activities.tip: This is prime visiting week — Halloween energy is highest. Go Friday or Saturday evening for the full costume parade atmosphere. Grab from central BKK ~150 THB.

activities.title: Carroll Prep Halloween Party 2026
activities.date: Check Carroll Prep for exact date (late October)
activities.why: School Halloween party open to the community — Thor gets the full costume-contest, trick-or-treat, party experience in a safe supervised setting. Perfect age for it.
activities.tip: Check carrollprep.ac.th for details and whether it's open to non-students. Good backup if Siam Halloween feels too crowded.

activities.title: Mega Bangna Halloween — Ghost Encounters & Shows
activities.price: Free entry to mall zones; game activities may charge
activities.why: Mega Bangna does Halloween big — ghost encounters (fun, not scary), themed photo spots, live shows, costume contests, and game zones. Easy afternoon out if you're near Bangna.
activities.tip: Check Mega Bangna's social media for exact programming this week. Easy to combine with IKEA or other Bangna errands.

activities.title: Doraemon Adventure at Sea Life — Final Days!
activities.date: Any day through October 31 (runs out this week!)
activities.location: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, B1–B2, Siam Paragon (BTS Siam)
activities.price: ~790 THB adults / ~590 THB kids (book Klook for ~20% off)
activities.why: Last week of Doraemon at Sea Life — if you haven't been yet, this is your final chance. Sharks, rays, penguins AND cartoon pals. Don't miss it.
activities.tip: Book Klook tickets before Oct 31. Weekday visit this week is your best bet to avoid the Halloween-weekend zoo. Last entry 7 PM.

activities.title: Ice Skating at Sub Zero — Ekkamai Daytime Sessions
activities.location: Sub Zero Ice Skate Club, Ekkamai, Bangkok
activities.why: Super affordable daytime skate sessions at Ekkamai — one of the most convenient rinks for families near Thonglor/Ekkamai. Thor gets dedicated practice time without evening-club atmosphere.
activities.tip: Daytime only for families (11 AM – 5 PM). Evening sessions are club-format. Easy to combine with Ekkamai food street for lunch.

activities.title: Roller Dome — Pre-Halloween Weekend Roll
activities.price: ฿50/hr or ฿100/day (skate rental + 15 min lesson included)
activities.why: Cap the month with a great rollerblade session at SE Asia's biggest indoor rink. Thor's been building skills all October — time to show off!
activities.tip: Try the all-day ฿100 pass and challenge Thor to his personal best lap time. Quiet weekday morning sessions before the Halloween weekend excitement.
